description: This file defines the feature for deleting comments within the Conduit application. It includes a command object, a validator for the command, and a request handler to process comment deletion by slug and comment ID, interacting with the database context.

classes.name: Delete.Command
classes.description: Represents the command to delete a comment, containing the article slug and comment ID.

classes.name: Delete.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates the delete command, ensuring the slug is not null or empty.

classes.name: Delete.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the delete comment request by locating the article and comment, then removing the comment from the database.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Executes the comment removal process asynchronously, throwing errors if the article or comment is not found.
